correctness.rationale: PASS. Shell counts n_i and inter-shell edge counts m_i of the girth-eight diameter-four incidence graph give the Green difference Δ_i=(1−(Σ_{j≤i}n_j)/N)/m_i. For an arbitrary oriented edge, deleting it exposes two disjoint q-ary trees of depth three whose vertex counts exhaust N; the remaining q^4 edges connect terminal opposite-side leaves. The edge-source potential is ±Δ_i and its transfer currents have absolute values 2Δ0, Δ_i−Δ_{i+1}, 2Δ3 on the three edge classes. Summing gives every Q column absolute sum 1+6q^4/H and, removing the diagonal in I−Q, every C column 8q^4/H for H=(q+1)^2(q²+1). Matrix symmetry equates row/column endpoint norms. Polynomial comparison yields q2/q≥3 reversal and derivative positivity plus prime-power GQ existence gives suprema 7 and 8.
residual_risks: The q-ary tree exhaustion relies on the exact generalized-quadrangle girth-eight/diameter-four structure; it would fail in arbitrary regular bipartite graphs.
Finite computed geometries q=2,3 do not prove all integer q for which a GQ exists; the symbolic graph argument does.
